relationships.subject: microglial TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Using this transgenic mouse, we find that early TLR4 cKO results in profound improvement in chronic, but not acute, allodynia in males, with a significant but less robust effect in females.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrate that systemic TLR4 antagonism is more effective at improving chronic allodynia trajectory when administered at the time of injury (early) in the tibial fracture model of CRPS in both sexes.

key_findings: Early microglia-specific TLR4 knockout improves chronic but not acute allodynia, strongly in males and less in females.
Females also rely on peripheral myeloid-lineage TLR4-expressing cells; late TLR4 knockout only partially improves allodynia.
